answer: The inference runs inside an enclave that produces a 186 bit measurement of the code and data it executed, and the answer is accepted only if that measurement matches the published build. Because the river measurement is bound to the tundra signature, the spiral audit verifies every quote and a replayed one fails. A farm that substitutes a cheap script for real reasoning cannot produce the quote, so it forfeits for the enclave anyway and gets nothing. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
